dct_description_sm: This is a data schema created using Agri-food Data Canada's Semantic Engine . Data schemas describe data that are collected on an ongoing basis from research centres, and provide add-on documentation that enhances the value of raw data. This schema is applicable to all datasets collecting data from reports of Feed Analysis from A&L Canada Lab. Feed analysis reports generated by A&L Canada Lab provide detailed information about the nutritional composition and quality of feed samples tested. This schema outlines the structure and format for organizing and managing the data obtained from these feed analysis reports. This data can also be integrated with other herd management data, such as milk production, health records, and reproduction data. Data described in this schema is sample data, to request access to the related data, please visit the Ontario Dairy Research Centre Data Portal.
